text:
Aisha (eng-platform): Heads-up — product wants a single dashboard that shows Cost per 1k tokens + breakdown for cache and batch savings by route/model/version. Need runtime/infra inputs. Who owns the event shape?
Tomas (eng-runtime): We can emit counters from the runtime: tokens_generated, tokens_charged, kv_cache_hits, batch_size_sum, request_count. Question: do we tag by routing policy (eg cost_route=cheap/fast) and model_variant?
Aisha (eng-platform): yes please tag with model, model_version, route_policy, customer_tier. Also add quantization_profile and seq_len_bucket. We need to be able to roll up by route and by customer.
Priya (eng-infra): We can add those labels but watch cardinality. Suggest seq_len_bucket (0-128,129-512,512+) instead of raw len. route_policy should be an enum.
Marc (observability): For the dashboard we need both raw counters and precomputed derived metrics. Proposal for metric names: 
```
redwood.runtime.tokens_generated_total
redwood.runtime.tokens_charged_total
redwood.runtime.kv_cache_hits_total
redwood.runtime.batched_requests_total
redwood.runtime.batched_tokens_total
```
Then a derived view: cost_per_1k = (sum(cost_tokens)/sum(tokens))*1000. Cache_savings_pct = kv_cache_hits * avg_kv_saved_tokens / total_generated.
Ken (product): We want the UI to show: overall cost per 1k, split: baseline model cost vs saved_from_cache vs batching. Also a per-route toggle for rollout comparisons.
Tomas (eng-runtime): Implementation note: we can surface avg_kv_saved_tokens as a gauge emitted on request completion. That plus kv_cache_hits_total should be enough. Batching savings is trickier — we can emit batched_tokens_saved per batch.
Aisha (eng-platform): Can you paste the minimal event JSON we should expect from runtime? Observability can wire it into metrics pipeline.
Tomas (eng-runtime): sample event: 
```json
{
  "timestamp":"@ts@",
  "model":"gptx-1b",
  "model_version":"2026-02-14",
  "route_policy":"balanced",
  "customer_tier":"self-serve",
  "tokens_generated":120,
  "tokens_charged":80,
  "kv_cache_hits":1,
  "avg_kv_saved_tokens":30,
  "batched_tokens_saved":10,
  "seq_len_bucket":"129-512"
}
```
Priya (eng-infra): That looks fine. We'll forward these to the metrics pipeline as both counters and sample events. We should also include a request_id and shard_id for debugging.
Marc (observability): For retention/rollups: keep raw events 30d, aggregated hourly 365d. We'll build a materialized view for daily cost per 1k by model+route. Need cost rate per token per model — where does that come from?
Aisha (eng-platform): Cost rate mapping will come from finance via a small lookup table we maintain in the console config. API: /config/cost-rates -> returns per-model token-cost (microunits). We'll join in the telemetry pipeline.
Ken (product): UX question: when customers run an A/B rollout using route_policy, can we show delta in unit cost side-by-side? Need 95% CI on cost estimates.
Marc (observability): We can run bootstrap CI over daily aggregates. For the dashboard add a toggle for confidence intervals.
Tomas (eng-runtime): One more flag: instrument fallback events separately (fallback_to_smaller_model true/false). Those inflate apparent savings but matter for quality regressions.
Aisha (eng-platform): Good point. Add fallback_to_variant and error_code if any.
Priya (eng-infra): Ops: we'll need a small schema rollout plan. Suggest: emit new fields behind feature flag for 2 weeks, then flip and bulk backfill hourly aggregates for 7 days.
Aisha (eng-platform): Proposed rollout: canary 5% of traffic for 48h, then 25% for 48h, then 100%. Owners: Tomas implements event shape by 1794590000, Priya wires pipeline by 1794620000, Marc builds dashboard panels by 1794650000.
Ken (product): :thumbsup: Please add brief text in the dashboard explaining assumptions (eg cost rates, seq buckets). Also add a "show raw counters" debug toggle.
Tomas (eng-runtime): I'll add the events and tests. Quick snippet to compute cost per 1k in SQL for the materialized view: 
```sql
SELECT model, route_policy, sum(cost_tokens)/nullif(sum(tokens_generated),0)*1000 as cost_per_1k
FROM runtime_events_hourly
GROUP BY model, route_policy;
```
Aisha (eng-platform): Perfect. Action items recorded. I'll open a follow-up doc with schema + example queries and link it here. Anyone object to that timeline?
Marc (observability): No objections. I'll reserve dashboard space and add the CI computation.
Priya (eng-infra): ACK, will coordinate infra tickets.
devops-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime-metrics-feature-flag -> canary at 2026-04-02T18:00Z
Aisha (eng-platform): Thanks all — I'll post the doc in #eng-platform and ping infra/obs when ready.
